# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Check revenue format
print(f'First 5 revenue values: {df["revenue"].head().tolist()}')

# Check for QA orders
qa_orders = df[df["revenue"] == "999999.99"]
print(f'Number of QA orders (revenue = 999999.99): {len(qa_orders)}')

# Check status values
print(f'Status value counts:
